responsibility: This header declares the small C wrapper API around GCC diagnostic colorization used by gm2. It exposes functions to start and stop named colors, retrieve open and close quote strings, and perform trivial module init/fini entry points, serving as the C declaration side of the diagnostic styling bridge in m2color.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header provides the C/C++ prototypes for the diagnostic color wrapper, including the wrapper init/finish functions. Unlike m2color.def it is not the Modula-2 declaration layer, and unlike m2color.cc it does not call diagnostic-color.h facilities itself.
